name: edgewallet-free-poller
description: Tiny no-credit poller for public @edgewallet posts via X syndication timeline.

scripts.smoke: tmp_cache="$(mktemp)"; node poll-edgewallet.mjs --limit 1 --json --cache "$tmp_cache" | node -e "let s=''; process.stdin.on('data', d => s += d); process.stdin.on('end', () => { const j = JSON.parse(s); if (j.authUsed || j.xApiUsed || j.xAiUsed) throw new Error('paid/auth path used'); if (!j.tweets[0]?.id) throw new Error('missing tweet'); console.log('PASS', j.tweets[0].id); })"; rm -f "$tmp_cache"
